latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image To Video — initial release

- Convert static images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 video clips using cloud GPUs.
- Automatic setup with anonymous token generation (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Simple workflows: upload images, describe output, receive download link for rendered video.
- Supports quick video generation with transitions, audio tracks, and text overlays.
- Common export, status, and credits actions via user-friendly commands.
